response:
I'm so sorry you experienced this betrayal and abuse. What you're describing—constant hypervigilance, difficulty trusting, reading between lines—makes complete sense given the manipulation you endured. Your brain is trying to protect you from being hurt again, which is a natural response to emotional abuse.

Healing from this takes time, and you don't have to force yourself to trust anyone right now. Consider working with a therapist who understands emotional abuse and coercive control—they can help you process what happened and gradually rebuild your ability to discern safe people from unsafe ones. Regarding the immigration fraud concerns, you may want to consult with an immigration attorney or contact the appropriate authorities to understand your options and protections. You deserve relationships built on honesty and respect, and what she did reflects on her, not on you or on women generally.
